blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — Authorities arrested a 32-year-old “high-value” drug suspect and seized some P2.84 million worth of suspected meth during an anti-illegal drug operation late Monday night in the municipality of Estancia, Iloilo. The suspect, identified by police as alias “Dave,” was arrested in his neighborhood in Barangay Poblacion Zone 2 at around 11:09 p.m. Operating elements of the Station Drug Enforcement Team of the Estancia Municipal Police Station, led by Lieutenant Adrian Baligod, conducted the buy-bust operation that led to the suspect’s capture.
